units: Cant. R. to III, 6 ממ׳ למ׳ from station to station; a. fr.—Pl. מַסָּעוֹת (fem.).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 94b:18">Snh. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>עשר מ׳ נסע וכ׳</he> that wicked man (Sennacherib) marched ten journeys in that one day; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 284">Yalk. Is. 284</cite>. Tanḥ. B’midb. 2 <he>ובאה עמהן במ׳</he> and it (the well) went with them on their journeys; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1:12">Num. R. s. 1</cite>. Tosef.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 3a">R. Hash. I</cite>II (II), 3 <he>ובמ׳</he> and the signal for marching (<cite ref="Numbers 10:2-8">Num. X, 2-8</cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 16:1">Pesik. R. s. 16</cite> <he>המַסָּעִים</he> the marches in the desert.—[Tosef.
